prompts: Use case: productivity-visual. Create a polished 16:9 slide BACKGROUND only, no text, no subjects in the center. Warm ivory cream paper (#FAF7ED), very faint thin gray square notebook grid, fine paper texture. Friendly Japanese hand-sketched teaching material. Main content area completely empty, edge decorations only. A small navy hand-drawn light bulb, coral sparkle and short wavy line tucked into upper right 5% margin, tiny navy stars at lower left 4% margin, thin subtle notebook margin at left. At x=5% to 74%, y=18% add ONE pale yellow hand-painted horizontal marker underline 1% of canvas height. Keep 90% of page empty. No writing, no words, no letters, no numbers, no logos. High resolution landscape.

Use case: illustration-story. A single contact sheet containing EXACTLY SIX separate spot illustrations, arranged in three columns and two rows of equal cells on transparent background. Every cell has at least 10% blank margin and no artwork crosses boundaries. Cohesive friendly Japanese educational notebook illustration style, dark navy hand-drawn outlines, soft watercolor washes in pale blue, butter yellow, warm coral, mint, ivory. Rounded friendly diverse Japanese adult characters, cute small white-and-blue robot, no logos, no text, no letters, no numbers. Top-left: woman business owner and cute robot working together at a laptop, cheerful. Top-center: small fluffy cloud cradling a laptop with a tiny robot at its keyboard, computer workspace in cloud metaphor. Top-right: robot sorting envelopes and calendar pages neatly on a desk. Bottom-left: salesperson preparing for a meeting with company documents, robot helping, magnifying glass. Bottom-center: cafe owner with phone and stack of social media photo cards, cute robot assistant. Bottom-right: robot making an illustrated poster, image card and short film strip with play triangle. Each of six vignettes distinct, self-contained, detailed but legible. Large landscape 3:2 composition. No words anywhere.
